'''Defte''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] researcher who was part of the expedition led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. When Tykan succumbed to the [[Dark Plague]] and turned on the researchers, Defte's ankle became trapped under a fallen support beam, and he was unable to move until a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] arrived and lifted the beam.
